title.value: EditNTS: A Neural Programmer-Interpreter Model for Sentence Simplification through Explicit Editing
title.justification: The title explicitly mentions the model proposed in the paper, EditNTS, and its purpose for sentence simplification through an explicit editing approach.
title.quote: We present the first sentence simplification model that learns explicit edit operations (ADD, DELETE, and KEEP) via a neural programmer-interpreter approach.

analysis.description: This paper introduces EditNTS, a neural programmer-interpreter model for sentence simplification. It differs from traditional sequence-to-sequence models by predicting explicit edit operations (ADD, DELETE, and KEEP) to simplify sentences. The model consists of a programmer and an interpreter that simulate human editing operations, aiming to produce simpler and better-quality simplified sentences. EditNTS outperforms existing state-of-the-art models in terms of SARI scores and is assessed as more effective in human evaluations.
